summary: The accepted certificates apply with the stated supports, tilts, entropy rows, capacities, and likelihood weights. The rank-linear price and rank-exponential surplus argument yields the displayed single product-wide coefficient. Actual-depth supermultiplicativity correctly restores vertex simplices and composes the interval group. The third-moment comparison, T^4 normalization, saturated affine transport, and intrinsic-rank assertions are exact. Smallest instances, empty products, singleton factors, boundary roots, zero-variance directions, and rank-zero embeddings reveal no counterexample or gap.
